robotsChecks.result: Collector rejects non-text robots response and stops UPSC fetches.
Changing to the bare host does not restore a usable robots policy.

applicationPortal.finding: Official legacy page says it is only for previewing applications submitted on or before 25 March 2025 and directs registration for future UPSC examinations to https://upsconline.nic.in/.

publicationImpact: Previously collected UPSC cycles are draft-only. The linked notification PDFs were never fetched and must not inherit their HTML page hashes. No current UPSC coverage or reviewed listing can be claimed from this failed check.
